definitions.gloss: handwriting with personal quirks; idiosyncratic penmanship
definitions.explanation: Handwriting whose individual style — slant, loops, oversized characters — makes it noticeably personal, often at the cost of legibility. Carries a slightly negative or apologetic nuance.

examples.english: My father's handwriting is quirky and hard to read.

examples.japanese: {癖字|くせじ}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{活字|かつじ}→活字：00202_katsuji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My handwriting is quirky, so I make sure to print on documents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{返|かえ}したら→読み返す：07954_yomikaesu⟧、⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{癖字|くせじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{懐|なつ}かしく→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧⟦{感|かん}じられた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: Rereading old letters, I felt nostalgic for my grandmother's distinctive handwriting.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{癖|くせ}→癖：03814_kuse⟧ (habit; quirk) + ⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧ (character; handwriting). The ⟦{癖|くせ}→癖：03814_kuse⟧ element gives it a mildly negative tone — usually about legibility, sometimes affectionate when describing a familiar person.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {癖字|くせじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write in quirky handwriting
- ⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧{癖字|くせじ}: terrible/illegible handwriting
- {癖字|くせじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}す: to correct one's handwriting quirks

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悪筆|あくひつ}→悪筆：27028_akuhitsu⟧: bad handwriting — straightforwardly negative, focuses on poor quality
- ⟦{達筆|たっぴつ}→達筆：26860_tappitsu⟧: skilled, flowing calligraphy — positive, often hard to read for the opposite reason
- ⟦{下手|へた}→下手：00703_heta⟧な⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧: clumsy handwriting — emphasizes lack of skill, not personality
